before.title: Asynchronous Is Nearly Free for Evolution Strategies on Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
before.description_en: Bounded-staleness asynchronous full-parameter Gaussian ES for long-horizon agents. Updates Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct weights using rewards without backpropagation in the proposed ES procedure. Backfill: first public 2026-10-03 UTC. Higher-lag experiments use controlled artificial staleness; large-scale wall-clock gains and venue status remain unverified.
before.description_zh: 在长时程智能体任务中，以有界延迟异步高斯ES通过奖励持久更新Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct全模型权重，所提ES更新无需反向传播。补收录：首次公开于2026-10-03（UTC）。较高延迟实验使用人为控制的过期更新；大规模实际耗时收益及会议状态待核实。

after.title: Asynchrony Is Nearly Free for Evolution Strategies on Long-Horizon LLM Agentic Tasks
after.description_en: Version 2 studies bounded-staleness asynchronous full-parameter Gaussian ES on WebShop with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, without backpropagation in ES updates. Version 1 terminal-task details are archived. First public 2026-10-03; the October 14 title/experiment revision is not a new paper.
after.description_zh: v2以Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507在WebShop上研究有界延迟异步全参数高斯ES，参数更新无需反传；v1的Qwen2.5及终端任务记录另存版本档案。首发2026-10-03，10月14日改题与修订不计新论文；每条件训练次数及真实耗时收益仍需谨慎核实。

primary_version_evidence.title: Asynchrony Is Nearly Free for Evolution Strategies on Long-Horizon LLM Agentic Tasks
primary_version_evidence.description_zh: v2以Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507在WebShop上研究有界延迟异步全参数高斯ES，参数更新无需反传；v1的Qwen2.5及终端任务记录另存版本档案。首发2026-10-03，10月14日改题与修订不计新论文；每条件训练次数及真实耗时收益仍需谨慎核实。
primary_version_evidence.description_en: Version 2 studies bounded-staleness asynchronous full-parameter Gaussian ES on WebShop with Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507, without backpropagation in ES updates. Version 1 terminal-task details are archived. First public 2026-10-03; the October 14 title/experiment revision is not a new paper.
primary_version_evidence.method: 有界延迟全参数高斯ES；持续更新语言模型策略权重，无反向传播。
primary_version_evidence.persistent_parameters: 是，Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507全参数；GRPO是独立一阶比较对象。
primary_version_evidence.contribution: v2改为WebShop上的过期反馈比例及延迟压力实验；不沿用v1终端任务结果描述。
uncertainties: 每个条件的单次训练结果不构成多次训练复现。
未独立验证真实部署吞吐收益；代码与v2逐项一致性待核实。
